service.title: Support for vehicles that work every day
service.lead: Downtime costs more than the repair. Parts, diagnostics and warranty terms are agreed in writing before delivery.

Wear parts stocked in the Nordics; other parts ordered with a stated lead time.
Diagnostics through the workshop network, with a courtesy vehicle on fleet agreements.

camper.privIntro: This page explains what we do with the details you send us through the forms on this site.
camper.p1x: EV Pickup AS, org.nr 936 223 478, Bjorøyvegen 332, 5177 Bjorøyhamn, Norway. E-mail: post@elbilnorden.no.
camper.p2x: Only what you type into a form: name, company, e-mail, phone, the van model or region you name, your message, and which language version you used.
camper.p3x: To answer your enquiry, arrange a test drive, and send you an offer or dealer terms. We do not use your details for anything else and we do not sell them.
camper.p4x: Steps taken at your request before a contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)) and our legitimate interest in replying to business enquiries (Art. 6(1)(f)).
camper.p5x: Enquiries that do not lead to an agreement are deleted after six months. Where an agreement is made, accounting rules decide the retention period.
camper.p6x: Our web host processes the message on our behalf as a data processor. CIE AS builds and operates the site and also acts as processor for the form data. No one else receives your details.
camper.p7x: We use Google Analytics for anonymous visitor statistics, but only if you accept it in the cookie banner; you can decline, and you can change your choice by clearing the site's data in your browser. Google Analytics is provided by Google Ireland Ltd; IP addresses are anonymised. Your language choice is stored locally in your browser and never sent to us.
camper.p8x: You may ask for a copy of your data, have it corrected or deleted, and object to our processing. Write to post@elbilnorden.no. You can also complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet).
camper.dealerTitle: Sell Hudson electric vans and Nordic Camper in your area
camper.dealerSub: We are building a dealer network across the Nordics and Central Europe. You handle sales and first-line service; we handle import, homologation, parts and the conversion range.
camper.dl1x: Dealer pricing, demo vehicle terms, marketing material, and training for sales and workshop staff.
camper.dl2x: Your own workshop or a service partner, a demo vehicle, and enquiries answered within a day.
camper.dl3x: Send the form. We reply with terms, margins and the territories still open, then arrange a test drive.
camper.camperFitText: It fits most vans of size L2H2 or larger. Send us your model and we will confirm the fit before you order.
camper.contactCamperSub: Tell us which van you have and how you travel, and we will put a set together for you.
camper.eqX1: Steel frame (Q345B), glass sliding doors at the rear and side with aluminium frames and mosquito nets, vinyl flooring and lightweight cabinets.
camper.eqX2: Upholstered sofa that converts into a bed (175/190 × 125 cm), 10 cm mattress, folding table and tall cabinet.
camper.eqX3: Stainless steel sink with its own tap, 40 l portable fridge, spice drawer, tall cabinet and base cabinet. 48 l fresh water tank and 48 l grey water tank.
camper.eqX4: Interior shower module with a passage to the driver's cab, and two portable 18 l water tanks.
camper.eqX5: LED mood lighting and prepared 12 V connections for a portable power station (not included).
camper.eqX6: Height-adjustable base with wheels, L-profiles and straps.
camper.eqPX1: Upright 50 l 12 V fridge instead of the portable fridge.
camper.eqPX2: Sink with cover, folding tap and 12 V water pump.

camper.h1: Work van in the week. Camper at the weekend.
camper.sub: A fully equipped module you slide in within minutes – with bed, kitchen and shower. No conversion, no new type approval.
camper.pr1x: The module sits on a height-adjustable base with wheels and is secured with L-profiles and straps.
camper.pr2x: No bodywork – the van keeps its type approval, insurance and inspection as before.
camper.pr3x: When the weekend is over, the module rolls out and the van is a work vehicle again.
camper.kitchenX: Stainless steel sink, fridge, spice drawer and plenty of cupboard space. The tanks hold 48 litres of fresh and 48 litres of grey water.
camper.sleepH: Sofa by evening, bed by night
camper.sleepX: The upholstered sofa becomes a 175/190 × 125 cm bed with a 10 cm mattress. A folding table and tall cabinet make room for breakfast and luggage.
camper.bathH: An indoor shower – even when it rains
camper.bathX: Interior shower module with a passage to the driver's cab, plus two portable 18-litre water tanks.
camper.videoSub: From work van to camper in a few minutes.
camper.priceSub: Both come fully equipped. Pro adds what you need for longer trips off the grid.
